# Environment — foundation

This repository reads its configuration from the **workspace vault**, never from a
file inside the repository. Nothing `.env*` is expected here, and nothing of the sort
may ever be committed.

## Run it with the vault injected

```bash
corral run --env dev --repo foundation -- <your command>
```

## Or generate the files, outside the repository

```bash
corral vault gen --repo foundation --all
```

```
<workspace>/.env/foundation.<env>        variables
<workspace>/.secrets/foundation.<env>     secrets
```

## Variables this repository needs

| Key                 | Scope | Environments | Kind |
| ------------------- | ----- | ------------ | ---- |
| _none recorded yet_ | —     | —            | —    |

Environments: dev, staging, prod. A key scoped to _this repo_ wins over a _shared_ one
of the same name.

## Manage them

```bash
corral vault resolve --repo foundation --env dev     # what is in effect, and where it comes from
corral vault set MY_KEY value --env dev --repo foundation
corral vault check                                # the security audit
```
